text-simple.describes: Three Letter pages of Helvetica text, no annotations

text-rotated-90.describes: One Letter page with /Rotate 90; text drawn unrotated in user space

text-rotated-180.describes: One Letter page with /Rotate 180; text drawn unrotated in user space

text-rotated-270.describes: One Letter page with /Rotate 270; text drawn unrotated in user space

text-cjk.describes: Stand-in: an A4 page of Latin Helvetica text. pdf-lib standard fonts have no CJK glyphs, so this file contains no CJK text until a redistributable CJK font is embedded

cropbox-offset.describes: CropBox [50 50 550 750] inside a Letter MediaBox; one Square annotation at user-space (100,100)

mixed-page-sizes.describes: Letter, A4 portrait, A4 landscape, square

annotated-markup.describes: One of each text-markup subtype on page 1

annotated-notes-threaded.describes: A note with two replies (IRT) and one standalone note

annotated-redact.describes: Two unapplied Redact annotations, one text-based with QuadPoints and one area

annotated-shapes.describes: Square, Circle, Line, Polygon, Ink and FreeText

standard-callout.describes: One Letter page with a FreeText callout: /IT /FreeTextCallout, a three-point /CL, /RD, /LE /OpenArrow, red /DA and an /AP drawing box, leader and arrow

callout-xref-stream.describes: standard-callout saved with object streams and an xref stream, so the FreeText sits inside an object stream

callout-incremental.describes: standard-callout plus a hand-written incremental update that rewrites the FreeText with /CL starting at (80, 560)

callout-encrypted.describes: standard-callout AES-256 encrypted by qpdf with an empty user password, so PDF.js opens it but the object reader skips it

callout-bad-xref.describes: standard-callout with startxref 7 bytes off the real xref table; PDF.js rebuilds the cross-reference

note-icon-ap.describes: One Text annotation with /Name /Key and an /AP /N stream

freetext-fonts.describes: Four FreeTexts: /DA font through the annotation /DR (Times-BoldItalic), a bare /Helv, the AcroForm /DR (Courier-Oblique) and a subset Arial-BoldMT

annotated-unsupported.describes: Link, Stamp and FileAttachment, which Inkbar counts but does not import

acroform-basic.describes: A text field and a checkbox (Widget annotations)

incremental-saved.describes: Two revisions: a base file plus one hand-written incremental update (xref section with /Prev) that adds a Highlight

object-streams.describes: Saved with object streams and an xref stream

encrypted-aes.describes: AES-256 encrypted by qpdf, user password "inkbar"

encrypted-rc4.describes: 128-bit RC4 encrypted by qpdf, user password "inkbar"

malformed-truncated.describes: First 40% of a valid file; no xref, no trailer

malformed-missing-xref.describes: Copy of text-simple with the xref table and startxref removed; readers must rebuild the cross-reference by scanning

scanned-no-text.describes: Stand-in for a scan: a grey rectangle with no image and no text layer

userunit-2.describes: Copy of text-simple with /UserUnit 2 on every page, so each page renders at twice its point size
